external_entities.name: customers
external_entities.description: People who browse and place orders through the mobile app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Mobile application used by customers to browse and place orders.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: API used by the mobile app to handle customer and order data.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Authentication is not known: "Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication".

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: Stock and inventory system that receives orders and handles dispatch.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS, our stock and inventory system

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: Gateway that sends dispatch confirmations by fax.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

processes.name: macros
processes.description: Spreadsheet macros that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: Database containing customer names, addresses, and the cards they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is not known: "nobody here can tell me ... whether the user database ... [is] encrypted".

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: File kept alongside SIMS containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is not known: "nobody here can tell me ... whether ... the flat file [is] encrypted".

data_stores.name: spreadsheet
data_stores.description: Spreadsheet containing the catalogue; it is stored on a marketing laptop in the office.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customers browse the catalogue and place orders through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: send orders
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API to submit customer orders.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: keep customers
data_flows.description: The web API stores customer information in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: customer name, address, and payment card

data_flows.name: hand over order
data_flows.description: The web API hands an order to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes customers a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: Nobody checks whether the fax arrived at the right place.
data_flows.data_description: confirmation with customer name and address

data_flows.name: change catalogue
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: The office location where the marketing laptop holding the catalogue spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The user database contains confidential data because it stores customer personal information and payment-card information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains customer name, address, and the card they paid with.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file contains confidential data because it stores delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains delivery addresses.
